title: Step 65-A Wholesale Experience canonical handoff, live discovery and scope freeze
description: MEDIUM-risk documentation/governance-only Step 65-A. Freeze the Wholesale Experience execution boundary from canonical main after terminal Step 64. Record current Storefront placeholders, customer wholesale runtime authority, OpenAPI/generated-contract gaps, authoritative customer-type/pricing/cart-quote boundaries, inherited Step-55 wholesale UX obligations and the staged A-I execution plan. No runtime, API/OpenAPI, database, dependency, pricing rule or business-rule mutation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Fresh live guard records canonical main, terminal Step-64 evidence, HOS-69 activation and absence of competing Step-65 writers before mutation.
Stage A records the three current Step-65 Storefront placeholders and freezes SF-E-07 through SF-E-10 plus journeys SJ-10 and SJ-11 as design intent only, never as API authority.

Current runtime wholesale application authority is recorded exactly: customer submit is idempotent, customer status is owner-scoped, applicant remains retail until staff approval, and staff/admin review/approve/reject stays outside Step-65 Storefront authority.

The current OpenAPI/generated-contract gaps for wholesale application submit/status response content are explicitly frozen as Stage 65-B readiness work; Stage A does not paper over them with untyped frontend models.

Wholesale identity/pricing authority is frozen accurately: CustomerProfile exposes customer_type, AuthSessionActor currently does not, Cart Quote resolves customer type server-side, CheckoutQuoteResponse exposes the resolved customer_type, and pricing accepts authoritative customerType plus quantity.
Frontend must not hardcode the wholesale quantity discount threshold or discount value; configuration/pricing/quote remain authoritative even though current configured default minimum is 11.

Frozen A-I execution plan isolates contract repair before frontend, separates application/status from approved wholesale commerce, preserves existing Cart/Checkout/Order authority, and reserves final acceptance/closure stages.
Stage A changes only its three documentation/governance paths; no runtime/API/OpenAPI/database/dependency/pricing/business-rule/Product-Design/current-state mutation is introduced.

Canonical completion requires exact-head Canonical CI and Phase A, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before Stage 65-B mutation.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 65-A is MEDIUM risk and requires no Human Gate. Stage 65-B mutation remains blocked until protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.
